title: DocuForge Foundation
pages: Purpose and architecture

CoMind DocuForge turns a publishing request into an editable source, a reference publication, and a receipt that binds both to evidence. DFG-001 establishes the Test workflow for Word, PDF, and binary storage in CoMind’s existing Google Drive.

The generator renders the editable Word source first and converts that file to PDF. The format registry describes how each supported format should be handled. The manifest links the source, publication, validation, and storage receipt. The Test workflow is invoked on demand.
Table of contents
Format registry
The registry covers Office files, PDF, CSV, SVG, PNG, JPEG, Markdown, and HTML. Format identification uses the extension. Format-specific validation checks the actual contents and rendered output.
Publishing workflow

Resolve the approved destination and disclosure classification. Generate the editable source and derive the publication. Inspect both, then hash the exact bytes. Upload without conversion. Retrieve the stored files under authentication and compare hashes, file types, sizes, and destination metadata before recording verified publication.
Format fidelity

Preserve PowerPoint sources when converting to Google Slides. Review animations, transitions, timing, and media in the converted file. For Google Sheets imports, check Excel formulas, charts, formatting, external links, and advanced features. Preserve the editable Word source alongside its PDF.
Governance and provenance

DFG-001 operates in CoMind Test. The Development Environment Contract and L4A govern the lane. The package is internal, and private Drive storage is scoped to the authorized folder. Separate authority is required for public disclosure and Production.

The manifest identifies the document and version, records source references and SHA-256 hashes, and links the PDF to its editable DOCX. It records the generation time and engine, issue, commit, PR, validation evidence, Drive receipts, and any measured costs. Unknown observations remain null.
Validation and acceptance evidence

Open the Word package, check its editable paragraphs, headings, table, and metadata, then render every page. For PDF, check text extraction, table of contents, index, page numbers, metadata, and visual layout. A missing, mismatched, or unauthenticated Drive readback prevents verified publication.
Executed results belong in the package manifest and the CoMind Development RunBook. Track implementation and review in GitHub issue #534 and PR #557.
Integration and roadmap

Drive holds the editable source and publication. GitHub holds the code, test history, and review evidence. CoMind’s existing RunBook holds operational checkpoints. A future hosted runtime should submit progress to the existing RunBook so AED and the Operator Console can consume it under their current authority.

Later increments can add conversion-specific Office and Google Workspace tests, reusable branded templates, publication approval routing, and governed search. Education Center integration is a future consumer.
